provenance.authority: Dylan's locally audited controlling product contract
provenance.transcription: The id, requirement and acceptance strings below are verbatim from the originating local coordinator's supplied canonical entries on 2026-10-13. This tracked projection has its own bytes and is not a copy or independent hash verification of the Windows source file. The 15 October five-D amendment explicitly supersedes LC-02 and adds LC-17–22; its prior wording is retained in fiveDWorkspaceAmendment.previousLC02. The 16 October Develop orchestration amendment adds LC-23–24 while retaining LC-01–22 verbatim.

requirements.requirement: One primary conversational Luci per person coordinates their work. People describe goals and changes; Luci asks useful questions, maintains intent and context, and routes work through the lifecycle.
requirements.acceptance: A person can start an idea and request a mid-build change through conversation without manually authoring or transporting phase artifacts.

requirements.requirement: Discover, Design, Develop, Deploy and Distribute are five revisitable, communicating phases, rather than a one-way wizard.
requirements.acceptance: Build, deployment, risk or commercial findings can reopen discovery or design, update affected versioned context and continue work with a traceable reason and preserved authority.

requirements.requirement: Discover and Design develop high-quality, structured, durable context that upstream development tools can ingest: intent, evidence, requirements, decisions, design, constraints and acceptance criteria.
requirements.acceptance: A harness receives an identifiable context revision, and a reviewer can trace generated work back to the relevant human intent and accepted decisions.

requirements.requirement: Develop launches and orchestrates existing upstream coding harnesses. Luci supplies context, environments, work coordination, review and delivery; it does not replace those harnesses' coding engines.
requirements.acceptance: A real supported upstream harness receives Luci context and produces observable code, checks and reviewable outputs through the integrated workflow.

requirements.requirement: Local Develop runs in an isolated Docker environment with scoped workspace, credentials, resources and owned lifecycle.
requirements.acceptance: A real provider-backed coding task runs inside Docker; host CLI execution, fixtures and manual code import are not substitutes.

requirements.requirement: Cloud Develop runs in isolated microVMs on the selected supported cloud provider.
requirements.acceptance: Actual microVM creation, harness execution, isolation, persistence/recovery and cleanup are demonstrated. A remote Docker container or ordinary shared VM does not satisfy this requirement.

requirements.requirement: A conversational change during development triggers the necessary discovery questions, design changes, context revision, implementation, validation and deployment work under established policy.
requirements.acceptance: Add a feature during an active build; the resulting app and deployment reflect the amended context, with obsolete work identified and no stale result silently accepted.

requirements.requirement: Deploy gets the reviewed application live and feeds operational results back into the same project context.
requirements.acceptance: A real deployed app is reachable and its intended behavior is checked; failed deployments and rollback or recovery retain truthful status and evidence.

requirements.requirement: Cloud teams have per-person Lucis coordinate against shared durable, versioned project context.
requirements.acceptance: Two team members' Lucis exchange accepted changes, track their provenance and dependencies, and converge on the shared project state across restart or temporary disconnection.

requirements.requirement: Team Lucis resolve routine concurrent changes under agreed authority and policy, notify affected agents and adapt their work without humans managing handoffs.
requirements.acceptance: A teammate requests a design change while another Luci builds; compatible changes are reconciled, conflicting or stale work is handled explicitly, and development continues using the agreed revision. No silent last-writer-wins or fabricated consensus.

requirements.requirement: Luci automates routine work within the user's and team's established authority. Material ambiguity or incompatible human intent is surfaced clearly; existing deployment and spending boundaries remain meaningful.
requirements.acceptance: Routine phase transitions and agreed changes do not require repeated manual approvals. Irreconcilable intent or actions outside the agreed authority produce a specific decision request instead of pretending the conflict is resolved.

requirements.requirement: The experience is clean, quick and usable with shadcn/ui; conversation and project work remain coherent across phases and projects.
requirements.acceptance: The real interface supports conversational work, project switching, context review, progress, amendment and recovery without requiring users to operate separate vendor administration screens for routine work.

requirements.requirement: Scheduling, priorities, project isolation, reviewed outputs, cancellation/restart recovery and whole-computer resource responsiveness remain required capabilities.
requirements.acceptance: Evidence covers at least four projects, durable isolated context, priority/scheduling behavior, recovery, and owned workers, browsers, servers and containers without disrupting unrelated work.

requirements.requirement: Reuse suitable open-source solutions and existing details through Glasses, preserving provenance and licences; integrate them to this contract rather than substituting their product scope.
requirements.acceptance: Material reuse decisions cite inspected original evidence, licensing, integration fit and limitations; demonstrations and fixture evidence are not presented as real-provider proof.

requirements.requirement: Cloud agent swarms are a first-class capability that is easy to enable. Primary Luci decomposes work into many smaller dependency-aware tasks and elastically schedules upstream-harness subagents, each in its own independently owned isolated microVM, then spins those VMs down as their work finishes.
requirements.acceptance: A real cloud swarm runs multiple independently owned microVM subagents concurrently, consumes exact scoped context, coordinates dependencies and amendments, integrates reviewable results, and demonstrates per-VM cleanup. Multiple processes or containers sharing one VM do not satisfy per-agent microVM isolation.

requirements.requirement: Swarm operation supports clear concurrency, resource and spending policy, priority/backpressure, durable task outputs/checkpoints, bounded retry, cancellation and restart reconciliation. It must not require humans to provision each VM or manage routine agent handoffs.
requirements.acceptance: A representative small-task fan-out workload has an explicit measured concurrency target within configured limits, with no arbitrary low product ceiling or claim of unlimited scale. Tests cover a mid-swarm context change, conflicting outputs, failure/cancel/restart, duplicate-create prevention and observed settlement of owned VM identities and retained charges. Uncertain provider outcomes remain visible and are reconciled, not silently dropped.

requirements.requirement: Home shows all accessible projects with durable per-person workspace-scoped pins. The rail shows each project once, with distinct working, needs-input and stopped indicators; a stopped project remains visible for 24 hours or until opened.
requirements.acceptance: Pins survive reload and do not affect teammates. Pinned active projects never duplicate. Concurrent working and needs-input remain distinguishable; opening acknowledges only observed stop events, and 24-hour expiry hides no pending input or running work and deletes no history.

requirements.requirement: Discover is an evidence-led agent conversation with document understanding and bounded OCR, useful dependent questioning, and a durable strategic brief grounded in source-linked facts, decisions and measurable requirements.
requirements.acceptance: A real text document and scanned-page upload can be extracted, inspected and corrected; source-linked answers and contradictions produce an accepted strategic/context revision for Design, with cancellation/restart and unsupported-document handling.

requirements.requirement: Design is a canvas with truthful agent-work animation, followed by integrated chat and direct WYSIWYG editing of the same durable versioned design. Approval produces an exact implementation context revision.
requirements.acceptance: Real generated designs support selection, drag/resize/content/property edits, chat amendments, undo/redo, keyboard access and reload recovery. Progress reflects actual work with reduced-motion support; later changes cannot silently rewrite approved or running work.

requirements.requirement: Develop closely follows the inspected Cube.computer workspace layout with repository/task navigation and resizable tiled real agent terminals, files, diffs and previews, while retaining Luci conversation, authority and upstream-harness execution.
requirements.acceptance: Users can operate actual agent sessions, review source and checks, rearrange panes and recover interrupted work in wide and narrow layouts. Completion advances through independently verified, reviewed and policy-permitted deployment rather than trusting model prose.

requirements.requirement: Distribute is the fifth revisitable stage for evidence-grounded risk assessment, go-to-market, presentations, proposals, pricing and supporting product documentation, with editable reviewed artifacts and useful file exports.
requirements.acceptance: Generate and inspect representative risk/GTM/proposal/pricing and presentation outputs with context/release provenance and unresolved assumptions. Verify DOCX/PDF, PPTX and XLSX export fidelity as implemented; drafts and stale evidence cannot claim verified delivery or compliance.

requirements.requirement: A team admin imports and versions risk requirements or controls from XLSX. Distribute assesses each project against that library, links evidence, generates review documentation and routes unresolved gaps into Discover/Design and the normal amendment/delivery loop.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise admin-only preview/mapping/import/reimport, duplicate and invalid rows, bounded parsing without macro/external-link execution, project/team isolation, evidence-linked assessments and review. Accepted gap proposals update affected context and work idempotently; changed evidence makes affected assessments and documents stale.

requirements.requirement: Approved Design produces a durable versioned orchestration contract for project or specialist orchestrators and upstream coding agents: exact context, team risk controls and standards, dependencies, ownership, decision and authority policies, quality checks, resources and recovery. One personal Luci remains the user liaison.
requirements.acceptance: Prepare, inspect and approve the exact contract without execution effects; capture it in real work and reconcile changed design/team policy without silently rewriting running scope. Measure routine decisions resolved without human intervention, retaining reasons and genuine escalations; the approximately 99% ambition is not an unverified guarantee.

requirements.requirement: Develop uses durable event-driven orchestrators and large policy-bounded communicating swarms to produce, independently check, review, repair and integrate real upstream work through verified running applications and permitted deployment. Task agents retain scoped isolation, causal context and replay-safe result/decision records.
requirements.acceptance: Observe concurrent real tasks, scoped messages and artifacts, duplicate/reordered events, amendment/conflict handling, cancellation/restart and retained resource outcomes. Verify code quality and working behavior independently, with useful progress/attention/stop controls and measured completion latency, accepted throughput, interventions, cost and host responsiveness. Model prose, idle sessions and fixture fan-out do not establish completion.

deliveryAmendment.authority: Direct Dylan request: Local, Bring your own cloud, Luci Cloud; easy BYO setup commands; product README; merge completed branch work onto main

fiveDWorkspaceAmendment.authority: Direct Dylan product review and explicit XLSX/rail follow-ups, 15 October 2026; bedtime direction prioritizes usable E2E development.
fiveDWorkspaceAmendment.implementationGate: exact committed root audit and active worker acknowledgments; existing auth/correctness fixes remain permitted
fiveDWorkspaceAmendment.deliveryPriority: Usable local idea -> approved design -> actual upstream code -> checks/review -> run or permitted deploy first; new five-D functionality proceeds without blocking independent lifecycle fixes.

previousLC02.requirement: Discover, Design, Develop and Deploy are four revisitable, communicating phases, rather than a one-way wizard.
previousLC02.acceptance: A build or deployment finding can reopen discovery or design, update affected context and continue work with a traceable reason.

developOrchestrationAmendment.authority: Direct Dylan direction: prioritize exceptional Develop speed, quality, user experience, design-derived orchestrators and large communicating swarms using team risk/standards context; Herdr and Firstmate references.
developOrchestrationAmendment.deliveryPriority: Real local Design -> upstream implementation -> independent checks/review/repair -> verified running app, with Develop orchestration first after active LC17/auth work; other four Ds remain required.
developOrchestrationAmendment.implementationGate: Root exact committed review and active worker acknowledgments before added-scope implementation; existing authorized work continues.
developOrchestrationAmendment.autonomyTarget: Approximately 99% of eligible routine decisions, measured with numerator/denominator/exclusions/reasons; not claimed achieved and no authority bypass.
developOrchestrationAmendment.userTestingGate: All agreed local five-D functionality integrated and meaningfully accepted, including exceptional Develop orchestration/quality/recovery; no MVP or demo handoff. Live Azure tests remain deferred; future Luci Cloud remains unavailable.
